title: Systems Programmer
tagline: Write the low-level software everything else runs on: compilers, runtimes, databases, OS.
about: Systems programmers build foundational software: operating systems, compilers, databases, browsers, runtimes and high-performance infrastructure. You'll work close to the hardware in C, C++ or Rust and care about memory, concurrency and every microsecond.
It's demanding and deeply rewarding, and the knowledge makes you a better engineer in any role.
day: Write performance-critical code in Rust, C or C++
Design data structures with predictable performance
Read and contribute to large codebases
